# Committed notebook specs

Notebook specs that ship in the repository, as `NotebookSpec` JSON. They exist so
`scripts/check_graders.py` has something true to audit: it refuses an empty discovery, so
this directory going empty turns CI red rather than turning the gate into a no-op.

**These are not what a reader opens.** Every graded notebook on the site is generated by
the model at request time and never passes through this gate — auditing those means
running the same two arms inside `leona_notebooks.pipeline`. What a fixture here proves is
narrower and still worth having: that the audit path runs end to end in CI, and that a
grader committed to this repository cannot be vacuous or impossible.

Adding one: write the spec as JSON with at least `slug` and `cells`, and run
`uv run python scripts/check_graders.py packages/py/notebooks/fixtures` before pushing.
